design_philosophy: IDE-inspired / Editorial SaaS. Optimize for speed, low-friction, and data clarity. Distinctive non-generic aesthetic avoiding 'AI slop'.

dashboard_cards.appearance: Flat, sharp-edged rectangles (rounded-none). 1px solid border. Raw structural layout.
dashboard_cards.hover_state: Slight push down effect with sharp shadow adjustments to mimic mechanical keys.
dashboard_cards.layout: Grid borders pattern, exposing the skeleton. Use subgrid where possible.

weekly_update_widget.layout: Compact inline row, designed for speed (<3 min input).
weekly_update_widget.traffic_light: Three sharp square toggles (Green, Yellow, Red). Active state fills with solid color, inactive is grayscale/outlined.
weekly_update_widget.timestamp: IBM Plex Mono, right-aligned, text-xs text-secondary.

sectioned_reflection_form.header: Heavy border-b-2 border-black, thick tracking on titles.
sectioned_reflection_form.inputs: Shadcn highly customized. No soft focus rings. 1px black border on focus, sharp corners. bg-white inside gray background.

dri_feedback_radio_groups.appearance: Segmented controls resembling IDE toggle groups. 1px border, connected buttons. Active item inverts to black background with white text.

manager_review_tabs.appearance: Boxy, stark tabs. No floating pills. Active tab has a heavy bottom border (e.g. border-b-2 border-black) or full inversion (bg-black text-white).

empty_states.appearance: Minimalist monochrome. Use ASCII art or CSS repeating-linear-gradient scanlines instead of generic vector illustrations.

ai_panel_placeholder.appearance: Distinguished by a subtle background texture (e.g., repeating diagonal lines or noise) and a monospaced 'AI_ANALYSIS_PENDING' header.

motion.hover_effects: Mechanical and snappy. No long fades.

icons.style: duotone or bold, matching the brutalist weight.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='submit-weekly-update-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic purple/violet 'AI slop' gradients.
Rely heavily on HTML/Tailwind for structural layout (grid, flex) and heavily customize Shadcn components to remove rounded corners (use rounded-none).
For the traffic light widget, use the specific colors defined in the colors.traffic_light object.
Use Phosphor icons. Keep the design extremely utilitarian, mimicking a high-end code editor or Bloomberg terminal.
Ensure the manager review tabs look like strict folder tabs, with the active state clearly differentiated by stark black/white inversion.
Incorporate the provided avatar images for team members, DRI, and contributors.
Implement data-testid on every clickable or interactable element.
